ci.title: Weekly check-in
ci.promptSub: 6 short questions, under a minute. Your partner's answers open once you've both answered.
ci.waitingSub: Until {name} answers, you can still change yours.
ci.ready: You've both answered — look at it together
ci.readySub: Side by side, your wishes, and how your weeks are going
ci.intro: The week of {date}. Be honest: 1 — not at all, 5 — very much.
ci.q3: We had enough closeness and tenderness
ci.q6: I have something to thank my partner for
ci.frozen: This week is closed: you've both answered, the answers stay as they are.
ci.gapsHint: Where your scores differ by 2 or more, it's a good reason for a calm talk.
ci.allClose: You see the week almost the same way 💞
ci.talk: You see this differently — talk about it calmly, no blame.
ci.trendEmpty: The chart appears once you've answered together for at least two weeks.
